memories.content: Co-founder 1 is one of the three co-founders of Brightline Software. They have not yet formed a final opinion on the January price increase and are aware that a decision must be made before the all-hands meeting on the 18th.

Brightline Software has three co-founders who jointly make major decisions. The January price increase is under consideration. The all-hands meeting is scheduled for 2026-12-18 at 10:00 AM Pacific Time. The co-founders can communicate with each other and with the team via email, messaging, or in-person meetings. The team expects to be informed of the decision at or before the all-hands meeting.
